Feather Fall.description: You or a creature you can see within 60 feet falls at a gentle rate, taking no falling damage until the spell ends.

Fireball.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point in range, then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

Shield.quote: “Five points between a hit and a story.”
Shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you against an incoming attack or Magic Missile.

Counterspell.quote: “Not today. Not while I'm standing here.”
Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell within 60 feet.

Hypnotic Pattern.quote: “Watch the lights. Just watch the lights.”
Hypnotic Pattern.description: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube, incapacitating those who look.

Misty Step.quote: “Silver mist, and a better point of view.”
Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Web.quote: “Anchor them first. Let the dice wait.”
Web.description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point within range, grasping and restraining foes.

Invisibility.quote: “Walk soft, stay close, and don't make me explain this twice.”
Invisibility.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends or they make an attack or cast a spell.

Fly.quote: “The stairs were always more of a suggestion.”
Fly.description: You touch a willing creature, giving it a flying speed of 60 feet until the spell ends.

Fear.quote: “Give them a direction to run: away.”
Fear.description: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears in a 30-foot cone, forcing them to flee.

Dragon’s Breath.quote: “Breathe deep and let them taste the spark.”
Dragon’s Breath.description: You touch one willing creature and imbue it with the power to spew magical elemental energy from its mouth.

Alter Self.quote: “Change the shape to fit the lock.”
Alter Self.description: You assume a different form, adapting your body for aquatic survival, disguise, or natural weapons.

Command.quote: “One word is plenty if you say it right.”
Command.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range, compelling compliance on its turn.

Chromatic Orb.quote: “A diamond's worth whatever element saves your neck.”
Chromatic Orb.description: You hurl a 4-inch sphere of energy at a creature, choosing acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.

Detect Magic.quote: “Read the room before you step into the fire.”
Detect Magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you and learn its school.

Speak with Animals.quote: “Animals know what animals perceive. Ask directly.”
Speak with Animals.description: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

Find Familiar.quote: “He’s a cow. He’s always been a cow.”
Find Familiar.description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose, bound to your service.

Fire Bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range to inflict swift damage.

Ray of Frost.quote: “Take their feet out from under them.”
Ray of Frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range, reducing its Speed.

Mind Sliver.quote: “Crack the shell before the hammer falls.”
Mind Sliver.description: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into the mind of one creature, weakening its next save.

Shocking Grasp.quote: “Touch them and leave. No opportunity attack.”
Shocking Grasp.description: Lightning springs from your hand to shock a creature and prevent it from taking reactions.

Light.quote: “Never spend a torch when a pebble will do.”
Light.description: You touch one object, causing it to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

Mage Hand.quote: “Never touch a lever you can pull from thirty feet away.”
Mage Hand.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range, manipulating distant objects.

Minor Illusion.quote: “A sound where they look; a crate where they don't.”
Minor Illusion.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

Prestidigitation.quote: “Warm tea, clean robes, and a spark for the pipe.”
Prestidigitation.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice and everyday utility.

Mending.quote: “Everything breaks. Most things can be convinced to stay whole.”
Mending.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, restoring broken items.
